title: বাতিল অর্ডারের পণ্য মুছুন
task: বাতিল (`cancelled`) হওয়া অর্ডারগুলোর সব পণ্য `order_items` থেকে মুছে ফেলুন।
hint: `DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled')`
solution: DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled');
verify: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled')) = 0 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM order_items) > 0
